title: 2.8.2.2 Dev : Insulin delivered message
symptom: In the DASH driver (and also in 2.8.2 main and EROS driver), the lower part of the insulin delivery message says x U has been delivered when the insulin has not been delivered yet, while the upper part correctly says x U will be delivered.
fix: The issue was resolved in a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/77e3c736085a99c36c73eee0c3d915caa13eba47
